eventDescription:
An engaging and interactive event was organized at the Vidhaigal office to enhance students' education, skills, and intellectual abilities through fun games and activities.
More than 20 students participated in the event with great interest and enthusiasm.
? Learning Through Games and Activities:
? Improving memory power
? Developing thinking skills
? Enhancing concentration
? Managing distractions
? Building teamwork and collaboration skills
Various essential skills were developed through enjoyable and interactive activities, making learning a fun experience for the students.
